services.name: Museum Exhibits
services.desc: Ranked by visitors to Northern Illinois as a top attraction, Midway Village Museum prides itself as a unique experience combing history, heritage and the exhibition of artifacts to create an unforgettable, educational visitor experience. A popular destination since 1974, Midway Village Museum is a 148-acre campus nestled among trees creating a step back in time ambiance. Located on the museum campus is a Main Museum Center and a 13-acre open air museum, the Victorian Village. The Main Museum Center offers visitors 20,000 square feet of interactive exhibits related to many aspects of life in early Northern Illinois and Rockford’s development and economic impact. blurb: History and stories of the past come to life at the award-winning Midway Village Museum in Rockford, Illinois. We invite you to visit and explore Midwestern life as it was during the early 1900s through artifacts, exhibits, special events and tours.
